races.title: Racing TV EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: The market will no doubt prove informative with several of these making their debut, BET YOU CAN'T getting the vote to enhance what has been an excellent year for the Boughey/Loughnane combination. Jalapeno Gal and Spiders From Mars also look likely types on paper for Ed Walker. BET YOU CAN'T (IRE) JALAPENO GAL SPIDERS FROM MARS (IRE)

races.title: Racing TV EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: Making her third start, JAHAMI failed to keep straight under pressure when demoted to second at Wolverhampton last month, but she's in top hands and remains open to improvement as she gains further experience. She is taken to see off the challenge of Lady's Grace who has made the frame in her 3 races so far, with Sand Dance also considered. JAHAMI LADY'S GRACE SAND DANCE (IRE)

races.title: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This is a fairly late debut for HIGHEST PEAK but he couldn't be in better hands and given his pedigree, he could easily outclass these. Lean D'Aislingean will find this easier than the handicaps he's been running in of late, while Crown Knott , a former stablemate of the selection, may show more this time. HIGHEST PEAK (IRE) LEAN D'AISLINGEAN (IRE) CROWN KNOTT

races.title: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Nursery
races.verdict: Preference is for ADMIRAL LEACH , who shaped as if he may come on for the run when finishing mid-field on nursery debut at Newcastle earlier this month. He's bred to be suited by this extra 1f and gets the vote ahead of Lopefernza , another with potential as she goes up in trip, while Angel of Heaven is one to note on her nursery bow. ADMIRAL LEACH (IRE) LOPEFERNZA ANGEL OF HEAVEN

races.verdict: MELODICAL showed improved form when getting up late over this C&D last month and she can go on to score again now that she's up and running. races.title: Unibet Floodlit Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: Successful at the highest level last summer, EL CORDOBES hasn't had things go his way in only 3 outings this year, so he is taken to get back to winning ways as he returns to listed level. Amiloc also brings Group 1 form to the table having been runner-up in last season's Irish St Leger and could be the main danger, with Constitution Hill also considered back down in grade. EL CORDOBES (IRE) AMILOC CONSTITUTION HILL

races.title: Unibet London Middle Distance Series (Final) Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: This series final can go the way of TRYFAN , who did well to get as close as he did when runner-up here 6 weeks ago. With the potential for plenty of pace in this race, he is fancied to reverse the placings with War Hawk from when the pair met last time, King's Code completing the shortlist as he bids to land this prize for a second year running. TRYFAN WAR HAWK (IRE) KING'S CODE
